support_levels.immediate: Supported by the production typed DOLFINx compiler now.
support_levels.compiler_extension: Fits the AES FEM architecture but needs typed operators and compiler work.
support_levels.advanced_backend: Needs a substantially different formulation, discretization, or solver backend.

use_cases.title: Laplace equation on an L-shaped domain
use_cases.prompt: Solve the Laplace equation Delta(u)=0 on the attached L-shaped 2D domain. Use u=1 on x_min and u=0 on y_min, x_max_lower, y_max_left, notch_vertical, and notch_horizontal. Execute the DOLFINx solve with stored artifacts.

use_cases.title: Poisson equation on an annulus
use_cases.prompt: Solve -Delta(u)=1 on the attached annulus. Use u=0 on the complete boundary, execute the DOLFINx solve, and store the mesh, solution, diagnostics, and visualization.

use_cases.title: Helmholtz equation in an annular cavity
use_cases.prompt: Solve -Delta(u)-25*u=1 in the attached annulus with u=0 on its boundary. Return the frequency-domain field and solver diagnostics.

use_cases.title: Static linear elasticity of a mounting bracket
use_cases.prompt: Compute the static displacement and von Mises stress of the attached mounting bracket. Clamp the mounting-hole walls and apply a downward traction to the top face.

use_cases.title: Stationary convection-diffusion around an obstacle
use_cases.prompt: Solve stationary convection-diffusion in the attached channel with cylinder. Use epsilon=0.01, velocity b=(1,0), u=1 at inlet, and zero diffusive flux at outlet and walls.

use_cases.title: Semilinear cubic reaction on an L-shaped domain
use_cases.prompt: Solve -Delta(u)+u^3=1 on the attached L-shaped domain with u=0 on the boundary. Report nonlinear convergence and the final scalar field.

use_cases.title: Nonlinear p-Laplace diffusion on an annulus
use_cases.prompt: Solve the p-Laplace problem with p=3 and f=1 on the attached annulus. Use u=0 on the complete boundary and report nonlinear convergence.

use_cases.title: Monge-Ampere equation on a square
use_cases.prompt: Solve det(D2(u))=1 on the unit square with convex solution constraints and prescribed boundary data.

use_cases.title: Transient heat diffusion through a finned heat sink
use_cases.prompt: Solve the transient heat equation on the attached 3D finned heat sink. Use alpha=0.01, f=0, u=100 on base_bottom, initial temperature u=20, final time T=1, and dt=0.01. Execute and store all result artifacts.

use_cases.title: Transient scalar transport around a cylinder
use_cases.equation: u_t - div(A grad(u)) + b dot grad(u) + c*u = f
use_cases.prompt: Simulate transient scalar transport through the attached obstacle channel with diffusion 0.01, velocity b=(1,0), inlet concentration 1, and initial concentration 0.

use_cases.title: Fisher-KPP invasion on an L-shaped habitat
use_cases.prompt: Simulate Fisher-KPP invasion on the attached L-shaped domain with D=0.01 and r=1. Use a localized initial population and zero-flux boundaries.

use_cases.title: Allen-Cahn interface evolution in a perforated plate
use_cases.prompt: Simulate Allen-Cahn phase evolution in the attached plate with a hole using a double-well potential.

use_cases.title: Viscous Burgers equation
use_cases.prompt: Solve the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation on [0,1] with nu=0.01 and a smooth sine initial condition.

use_cases.title: Porous-medium flow on an L-shaped domain
use_cases.prompt: Solve the porous-medium equation with m=2 on the attached L-shaped domain from a compact initial profile.

use_cases.title: Cahn-Hilliard phase separation in an annulus
use_cases.prompt: Simulate Cahn-Hilliard phase separation in the attached annulus and track mass and free energy.

use_cases.title: Incompressible Navier-Stokes flow around a cylinder
use_cases.equation: rho*(u_t + (u dot grad)u) - mu*Delta(u) + grad(p) = f, div(u)=0
use_cases.prompt: Simulate incompressible flow around the cylinder in the attached channel and visualize velocity and pressure.

use_cases.title: Wave propagation on an L-shaped membrane
use_cases.prompt: Simulate the wave equation on the attached L-shaped membrane with a localized initial displacement.

use_cases.title: Passive scalar transport through an obstacle channel
use_cases.prompt: Transport a passive scalar through the attached channel with b=(1,0), inflow value 1, and initial value 0.

use_cases.title: Electromagnetic waves in a 3D cavity
use_cases.prompt: Compute electromagnetic cavity modes in the attached 3D domain using perfectly conducting boundaries.

use_cases.title: Inviscid Burgers shock formation
use_cases.prompt: Solve inviscid Burgers equation on [0,1] from a smooth initial condition through shock formation.

use_cases.title: Compressible Euler flow through an obstacle channel
use_cases.prompt: Simulate compressible Euler flow through the attached channel and resolve the wake and pressure field.

use_cases.title: Shallow-water propagation through an L-shaped basin
use_cases.prompt: Simulate a shallow-water pulse in the attached L-shaped basin with reflective walls.

use_cases.title: Schrodinger evolution in an annular potential well
use_cases.prompt: Evolve a Gaussian wave packet in the attached annular domain and visualize probability density.

use_cases.title: Eikonal travel time around an obstacle
use_cases.prompt: Compute Eikonal travel time through the attached channel around the cylindrical obstacle.
